caption:
The metric that grows Instagram accounts isn't likes. It's sends.

Instagram has said it plainly: when people share your post in DMs, that's one of the strongest signals for showing it to people who don't follow you yet.

A like is a nod. A send is a recommendation.

So stop asking "will people like this?" and start asking "who would they send this to?"

Posts that get sent usually do one of three things:
→ Name a problem someone's friend has
→ Settle an argument
→ Save someone time or money

Check your insights: sort your posts by shares, not likes. That's your real content strategy.

📌 You know exactly who needs to see this. Send it.
